docstring: It is also known that every $C^2$ Jordan curve admits an inscribed square.
references: [A Survey on the Square Peg Problem](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/274622766_A_Survey_on_the_Square_Peg_Problem) by *Benjamin Matschke*
type_pretty:
∀ (γ : Circle → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
  Topology.IsEmbedding γ →
    ContMDiff (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))) (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) 2
        γ →
      ∃ t₁ t₂ t₃ t₄, InscribedSquare.IsRectangle (γ t₁) (γ t₂) (γ t₃) (γ t₄) 1
